**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear description of the problem. E.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen. If this touches resolver behavior, remember
FixProve's core promise is **determinism** — any proposed change should
describe what a before/after example would look like.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've tried.

**Which part of FixProve does this affect?**
- [ ] `/cli` (open-core resolver CLI)
- [ ] `/app` (GitHub App / CI check)
- [ ] `/web` (marketing site)
- [ ] Not sure

**Additional context**
Anything else — links, screenshots, related issues.
